## 1. データ読み込み

```{r}
# ================================================================================
# 0. 初期設定・パッケージ読み込み
# ================================================================================
library(tinytex)
library(here)
library(haven)
library(glmnet)
library(tidyverse)
# library(fastDummies)
library(nnet)      # 多項ロジスティック回帰
library(survey)    # 重み付き統計解析
library(did)       # Staggered DID用（必要に応じて）
library(sjlabelled)　# ラベル付きデータ処理用
library(tableone)
library(fixest)   # 回帰分析の推定結果から係数表（推定値、標準誤差、t値、p値など）を抽出

# オブジェクトクリア
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))

# デバッグモードフラグ
debug_mode = TRUE  # デバッグモード
# debug_mode = FALSE # 通常モード

# 自作関数読み込み
source("../myTools.R")

# ================================================================================
# 1. データ読み込み
# ================================================================================
# DHSデータのルートフォルダを指定
gdrive_dir <- "/Users/snakada/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-snakada@g.ecc.u-tokyo.ac.jp/マイドライブ/Peru_work/Peru_endes/spss"

gdrive__dir_enaho <- "/Users/snakada/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-snakada@g.ecc.u-tokyo.ac.jp/マイドライブ/Peru_work/Peru_enaho"

# 結果保存先
save_path <- file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", "lasso_stunting")

df_org <- readRDS(
    file.path(gdrive_dir, "output","all_data_merged.rds")
  ) %>% filter(!is.na(nt_ch_stunt))

    file.path(gdrive__dir_enaho, "output","food_consumption_by_area_income.rds")
  ) %>% 
  select(-ends_with("_se")) %>%
  select(-c("area_income")) %>%

# 食品消費データ結合

var_labels$varname <- names(df_org)
```

## 2. LASSO用データ前処理

```{r}
# ================================================================================
# 2. LASSO用データ前処理（介入前データのみ）
# ================================================================================
library(gt)

# 除外変数定義(初期値)
drop_cols_init <- c(
"b3","b4","b5","b9","bidx","caseid","hc27","hhid","m1","m13","m14","m15","m1d",
"m2a","m2b","m2c","m2d","m2e","m2f","m2g","m2h","m2i","m2j","m2k","m2l","m2m",
"m3a","m3b","m3c","m3d","m3e","m3f","m3g","m3h","m3i","m3j","m3k","m3l","m3m",
"m3n","m42c","m42d","m42e","m43","m45","m60","m61","v001","v002","v003","v005",
"v008","v012","v013","v021","v022","v024","v025","v026","v106","v190","v208",
"v467b","v467c","v467d","v467f",
"wt","state","age","treated_status","treatment_start","year_treated", 
"dm_poorest","dm_poorer","dm_middle","dm_richer","dm_richest"
)

# 除外変数定義
drop_cols_add <- c()

# 目的変数と同値となる除去変数("nt_ch_sev_stunt", "nt_ch_haz", "nt_ch_stunt"のうち2つ)
y_var_all <- c("nt_ch_stunt", "nt_ch_sev_stunt", "nt_ch_haz", "nt_ch_sev_wast", "nt_ch_wast", "nt_ch_whz", "nt_ch_ovwt_ht", "nt_ch_ovwt_age", "nt_ch_underwt", "nt_ch_sev_underwt", "nt_ch_any_anem", "nt_ch_mod_anem", "nt_ch_sev_anem")
y_var <- "nt_ch_stunt"


# ID・管理用変数
grouping_cols <- c("caseid", "state","treated_status", "treatment_start","group_treated",
                   "wt", "treatment_group", y_var)

# *******************************************************************************
# LASSO用データ作成関数
#' @title create_lasso_data
#' @description LASSO用のデータセットを作成する関数
#' @param df 元データフレーム
#' @param drop_cols_init 除外変数定義(初期値)
#' @param drop_cols_add 除外変数定義(追加)
#' @param grouping_cols ID・管理用変数
#' @param y_var_all 目的変数候補
#' @param y_var 目的変数
#' @return リスト(df_lasso, covariate_names)
# *******************************************************************************
create_lasso_data <- function(df, 
          drop_cols_init, 
          drop_cols_add, 
          grouping_cols,
          y_var_all,
          y_var) {

  # 除外変数定義(最終値)
  drop_cols <- c(drop_cols_init, y_var_all, drop_cols_add) %>% unique()
  y_var_drop <- setdiff(y_var_all, y_var)

  
  # 1. LASSO用のデータセット定義
  df_lasso <- df
  
  cat("介入前データの群別サンプル数:\n")
  print(table(df_lasso$treatment_group))
  
  # 4. NAの多い列を除去（10%以上NA）
  initial_cols <- ncol(df_lasso)
  keep_cols <- names(df_lasso)[sapply(df_lasso, function(x) sum(is.na(x)) <= nrow(df_lasso) * 0.1)]
  df_lasso <- df_lasso[, keep_cols]
  cat("NA値の多い列を", initial_cols - ncol(df_lasso), "個削除しました\n")
  
  # 5. 共変量名の再定義（NA除去後）
  all_drop_cols <- intersect(drop_cols, names(df_lasso))
  grouping_cols <- intersect(grouping_cols, names(df_lasso))
  covariate_names <- setdiff(names(df_lasso), c(all_drop_cols, grouping_cols))
  
  
  # 6. 共変量のNAがある行を除去
  # df_lasso <- df_lasso[, covariate_names]
  complete_idx <- complete.cases(df_lasso)
  initial_rows <- nrow(df_lasso)
  df_lasso <- df_lasso[complete_idx, ]
  cat("NA値を含む行を", initial_rows - nrow(df_lasso), "行削除しました\n")
  cat("最終的な介入前データサイズ:", nrow(df_lasso), "行 ×", ncol(df_lasso), "列\n\n")
  
  return(list(df_lasso = df_lasso, covariate_names = covariate_names))
}
# --- 関数ここまで ------------------------------------------------------------

# LASSO用データ作成
df_lasso_data <- create_lasso_data(df_org, drop_cols_init, drop_cols_add, grouping_cols, y_var_all, y_var)
df_lasso <- df_lasso_data$df_lasso
covariate_names <- df_lasso_data$covariate_names


```

## 3. LASSO①による変数選択

```{r}
library(gt)
# ================================================================================
# 3. LASSO変数選択（介入前データ）
# ================================================================================
# 完全に一から再開
cat("=== データ処理を再開 ===\n")
cat("df_lasso の次元:", dim(df_lasso), "\n")
cat("covariate_names の数:", length(covariate_names), "\n")

# Step 1: model.matrix作成
cat("Step 1: model.matrix作成中...\n")
X_matrix <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = df_lasso[, covariate_names, drop=FALSE])
Y <- df_lasso$nt_ch_stunt

cat("=== 問題列の除去 ===\n")
# Step 1: 標準偏差が0の列を特定・除去
col_sds <- apply(X_matrix, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
zero_sd_cols <- is.na(col_sds) | col_sds == 0
cat("除去する定数列の数:", sum(zero_sd_cols), "\n")

if(sum(zero_sd_cols) > 0) {
  cat("除去する列名:\n")
  print(colnames(X_matrix)[zero_sd_cols])
  
  # 定数列を除去
  X_matrix_clean <- X_matrix[, !zero_sd_cols, drop = FALSE]
} else {
  X_matrix_clean <- X_matrix
}

cat("列除去後のX_matrix次元:", dim(X_matrix_clean), "\n")

# Step 2: スケーリング実行
cat("=== クリーンなデータでスケーリング ===\n")
X_scaled <- scale(X_matrix_clean)

cat("スケーリング後の次元:", dim(X_scaled), "\n")
cat("スケーリング後のNA数:", sum(is.na(X_scaled)), "\n")

# Step 3: まだNAがある場合の詳細チェック
if(sum(is.na(X_scaled)) > 0) {
  cat("=== 残存するNA問題の詳細分析 ===\n")
  
  # 各列のNA数をチェック
  col_na_counts <- apply(X_scaled, 2, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
  problematic_cols <- col_na_counts > 0
  
  cat("NA値を含む列数:", sum(problematic_cols), "\n")
  if(sum(problematic_cols) > 0) {
    cat("問題のある列:\n")
    print(col_na_counts[problematic_cols])
    
    # 問題のある列を除去
    X_scaled <- X_scaled[, !problematic_cols, drop = FALSE]
    cat("問題列除去後の次元:", dim(X_scaled), "\n")
  }
}

# Step 4: 最終確認
cat("=== 最終確認 ===\n")
cat("X_scaled次元:", dim(X_scaled), "\n")
cat("X_scaledのNA数:", sum(is.na(X_scaled)), "\n")
cat("Y長さ:", length(Y), "\n")
cat("Y分布:", table(Y), "\n")


# データが正常な場合のLASSO実行
if(nrow(X_scaled) > 0 && ncol(X_scaled) > 0 && sum(is.na(X_scaled)) == 0) {
  cat("=== LASSO実行 ===\n")
  set.seed(123)
  
  cv_model <- cv.glmnet(X_scaled, Y, 
                       alpha = 1, 
                       family = "multinomial", 
                       nfolds = 3)
  
  cat("LASSO実行成功！\n")
} else {
  cat("まだデータに問題があります\n")
}

cat("最適λ (lambda.min):", cv_model$lambda.min, "\n")
cat("1se λ (lambda.1se):", cv_model$lambda.1se, "\n\n")

# 選択された変数の抽出
coef_min <- coef(cv_model, s = "lambda.min")
selected_vars <- c()
for(i in 1:length(coef_min)) {
  coef_matrix <- as.matrix(coef_min[[i]])
  class_vars <- rownames(coef_matrix)[coef_matrix[,1] != 0 & rownames(coef_matrix) != "(Intercept)"]
  selected_vars <- union(selected_vars, class_vars)
}

cat("LASSO選択変数数:", length(selected_vars), "\n")
if(length(selected_vars) > 0) {
  cat("選択された変数:\n")
  for(i in 1:length(selected_vars)) {
    cat(i, ":", selected_vars[i], "\n")
  }
  
  # 係数行列の取得（multinomialの場合は最初のクラスを使用）
  coef_mat <- coef(cv_model, s = "lambda.min")
  if(is.list(coef_mat)) {
    coef_mat <- coef_mat[[1]]  # multinomialの場合
  }
  
  # 重要度計算
  coef_importance <- abs(as.matrix(coef_mat))
  
  # データフレーム化（明示的にdata.frameとして作成）
  coef_df <- data.frame(
    labels = rownames(coef_importance),
    lambda.min = coef_importance[,1],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # 選択変数のみフィルタリングしてラベル結合
  coef_importance <- coef_df %>%
    filter(labels %in% selected_vars) %>%
    left_join(var_labels, by = c("labels" = "varname"))  # ←
  
  # tibbleであることを確認
  coef_importance <- as_tibble(coef_importance)
  
  saveRDS(coef_importance, file.path(save_path, "lasso_selected_vars_importance.rds"))
  write.xlsx(coef_importance, file.path(save_path, "lasso_selected_vars_importance.xlsx"))

  #   # gt()で表示（列名で指定）
  # coef_importance %>%
  #   gt() %>%
  #   cols_width(
  #     labels ~ pct(15),
  #     lambda.min ~ pct(15),
  #     labels.y ~ pct(70)  # 残りの列（おそらくvar_labelsのラベル列）
  #   ) %>%
  #   fmt_number(
  #     columns = "lambda.min",
  #     decimals = 4
  #   )     
} else {
  stop("変数が選択されませんでした。λの値を調整してください。")
}

```

# 4. 選択変数でのIV-GLM実行

```{r}
library(survey)

# ================================================================================
# 1. LASSOの結果から上位20変数を抽出（年ダミー除外）
# ================================================================================
selected_predictors <- c("nt_wm_ht", "ch_below_2p5", "dm_children_under12", "rc_edu", "dm_sheep_own", "rh_anc_pvskill", "dm_refrigerator", "nt_wm_ovobese", "ph_wtr_time", "dm_age_of_hh_head", "dm_capital", "ph_sani_open", "dm_cooking_fuel_traditional", "dm_weath_index", "rh_prob_permit", "ms_afm_15", "ph_wtr_trt_cloth", "ch_stool_safe", "dm_dvjustify_onereas", "nt_mdd"
)

# ================================================================================
# 2. sampling weightの年次補正
# ================================================================================
# 年ごとの元 v005 合計を算出
year_totals <- df_lasso %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(total_v005 = sum(v005, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

# Survey designオブジェクトの作成前に変数を変換
df_lasso <- df_lasso %>%
  mutate(
    v021 = as.numeric(v021),                        # Primary Sampling Unit
    v022 = as.character(haven::as_factor(v022))    #haven_labelledをfactorに変換してからcharacter
  )

# 正規化済みサンプリングウェイトの作成
df_lasso <- df_lasso %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("total_v005"))) %>% # 存在する場合のみ削除
  left_join(year_totals, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(
    # 元のDHSウェイト
    dhs_weight = v005 / 1e6,
    # 年次正規化係数：全期間対象の標本サイズ比 (例：年の全体ウェイト比)
    year_norm = total_v005 / sum(year_totals$total_v005),
    # 正規化済みウェイト
    sampling_weight_norm = dhs_weight / year_norm,
    # 極端値トリミング
    sampling_weight_trimmed = pmax(
      pmin(sampling_weight_norm,
           quantile(sampling_weight_norm, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)),
      quantile(sampling_weight_norm, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

# ================================================================================
# 3. surveydesignオブジェクトの作成
# ================================================================================
library(survey)
library(glmnet)

# Survey designオブジェクトの作成
svy_design <- svydesign(
  ids = ~v021,          # Primary Sampling Unit (クラスター)
  strata = ~v022,       # 層化変数
  weights = ~sampling_weight_trimmed,
  data = df_lasso,
  nest = TRUE           # 入れ子構造
)

# 孤立PSUの処理
options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")
print("Survey designオブジェクトが作成されました")

# ================================================================================
# 4. 1st stage: dairy_log1p_scoreを予測（survey-weighted）
# ================================================================================
# 変数選択された共変量+juntos_non_participationを使用
formula_1st <- as.formula(
  paste("dairy_log1p_score ~", paste(c("juntos_non_participation", selected_predictors), 
                    collapse = " + "))
)

print("1st stageの式:")
print(formula_1st)

# survey-weighted 1st stage regression
fit1_svy <- svyglm(formula_1st, design = svy_design, family = gaussian())

# 予測値を元のデータフレームに追加
svy_design$variables$pred_dairy <- predict(fit1_svy, type = "response")

# Survey designオブジェクトを再作成（pred_dairyを含む）
svy_design <- svydesign(
  ids = ~v021,
  strata = ~v022,
  weights = ~sampling_weight_trimmed,
  data = df_lasso,
  nest = TRUE
)

print("pred_dairy変数を含むsurvey designオブジェクトを再作成しました")
# ================================================================================
# 5. 2nd stage: pred_dairyでStuntingを予測（survey-weighted）
# ================================================================================
formula_2nd <- as.formula(
  paste("stunting ~ ", paste(c("pred_dairy", selected_predictors), 
                    collapse = " + "))
)

print("2nd stageの式:")
print(formula_2nd)

# survey-weighted 2nd stage regression
fit2_svy <- svyglm(formula_2nd, design = svy_design, family = quasibinomial())

# 結果の表示
summary(fit1_svy)
summary(fit2_svy)

# 係数の取得
coef1 <- coef(fit1_svy)
coef2 <- coef(fit2_svy)

print("1st stage係数:")
print(coef1)

print("2nd stage係数:")
print(coef2)


```
